source_checks.claim: External lease acquisition precedes shared bounds checks, or map overwrite leaks an existing lease.
source_checks.disposition: REJECTED; the response repeatedly retracts its own counterexample with This is correct. The actual shared entry/handle/byte check is before LedgerFiles.lease. Existing external source lookup/Pin verification/read returns before new admission. Sources.put cannot replace a same-reference prior entry along this single-owner path.
source_checks.additional_source: Internal CAS readPublication preserves the existing fallback path; a valid but unretained result poisons transient custody via missing entries, rather than silently granting it. Acquired external leases are closed on unsuccessful admission with original failure preserved.

source_checks.claim: verifySources lacks an unknown flag check.
source_checks.disposition: REJECTED; verifySources explicitly throws when unknown, then validates retained CAS/external leases and current/root checks. The supplied complete source contains the check; no missing declaration caused this claim.

source_checks.claim: trace.requireEligible checks seal state, and retainedDependencies throws when unknown.
source_checks.disposition: REJECTED; trace.requireEligible checks active lifetime and monotone unknown. The Archive wrapper requireActive independently checks admitted. RetainedDependencies returns Optional.empty on unknown; caller orElseThrow rejects it. A present empty set is not Optional.empty and is not a new defect.
